native.scope: Same image, same native panel toggles/title drags and idle/scroll/disk root workload, with zero or two counter Tasks. Feedback is physical release stimulus scheduling after a four-frame press hold through the first exact native label scanout; includes input injection delay and up to one-frame scanout observation quantization. Counter/GUI markers add development-only work. No PI4/HY4 qualification.

memory.upper_heap: Per-counter live/reserved 2052/2088; controller 869/888; two plus controller 4973/5064. Existing AES service 988/992, DISPLAY and 92-byte scratch as WA3/WA4. WA6 adds no persistent production state; fixed VRAM unchanged.

fixes.problem: Queued update locks suppressed an existing console text continuation, retaining the scene token indefinitely.
fixes.change: Allow only unit-zero frozen continuation before lock admission and prioritize that source over other views.

fixes.problem: A partial scene exposure marked all dirty console rows clean.

before.oracle: Unchanged full-frame recomposition; not a previously recorded caret artifact.

fixes.change: Only successful full-window repaint acknowledges all dirty model rows; partial exposure preserves unpainted model damage.

limitations: PI4/HY4 remain open; eight releases per native cohort give p95=max, not a broad latency acceptance test.
Native release-to-visible includes physical scheduling and up to one-frame scanout observation quantization; counter repaint ends at END_UPDATE return after fenced pixels, not scanout.
Timing image contains diagnostic C markers and a small native notification branch; the packaged image and its walkthrough contain none of those hooks.
Two older caret cases remain open: x8-15/y87 after panel close and x48-55/y207 after scroll/move. No framebuffer exceptions were introduced; none of the final WA6 comparisons reproduced them.
Matched means identical offered root workload and native gesture sequence, not fixed achieved throughput or identical scene geometry; the counter cohort adds two active application windows.
No resource/menu/resize/general event profile or dynamic GEM executable loader; rebuilt source compatibility only.
reproduction: Extract exec816-demo.zip, check every SHA256SUMS entry and permitted distribution contents.
